query-parsed.eventDescription: One successfully parsed seed or expanded query: $2 per 1,000 checks. Charged even when filters, exclusions, duplicates or monitoring leave zero rows. Failed/unrecognized responses and invalid input are not charged. A separate delivered-row fee applies. No start fee; compute included. No extra source account or API key. Work stops before a new check when the Apify run option maxTotalChargeUsd cannot cover that check plus one row.

suggestion.eventDescription: One delivered suggestion row: $0.1 per 1,000 rows. Row keys: seed, expanded_query, suggestion, position, country, language. Filtered, duplicate, excluded and unchanged rows are not charged. Successful source checks are separately billed at $0.002 each, including empty checks. No start fee; compute included. maxTotalChargeUsd is an Apify run option, not input.
